summary: Fight the scary witch in the most terrifying chapter of Tom's adventures!
description: Start a scary and full of screams adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of the new icey horror made by Death Park and Mimicry developers! 💣 Say hello to this horror game where you'll have to immerse yourself in a thrilling and exciting adventure together with the main characters! Children have been missing for a long time in Lakewitch, and you are destined to solve this icey creepy mystery. Who is the kidnapper, and why is he doing it? Where are the children disappearing to, and how to save them? You can solve all the puzzles and find out the answers...if you don't get scared and wake up your neighbor with screams! 💀 In this episode you will come face to face with Wanda the Witch, and also meet new friends. You will open many completely new locations, and learn more about the past of the terrible child kidnapper, which will lead you to new frightening discoveries. On the way to the goal, puzzles, moments of horror, unexpected turns and a lot of fun await you! 😃🤘🏻 The story will develop rapidly and very unpredictably. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to the neighborhood of America of the '90s! 👍 Features of the adventure puzzle game Horror Tale 3: ★ Mysterious and fascinating story ★ Scary antagonist that will make you scream and interesting neighbor characters ★ Puzzles, riddles, and items to search ★ 5 diverse locations ★ Nice stylized graphics ★ Original author's soundtrack Horror Tale is similar to Ice Scream, Evil Nun and Hello Neighbor, but with an intriguing story that will unfold over several episodes. 😈 Immerse with your friends and neighbors into a thrilling entertaining adventure in our full of screams multi-part horror series!
